about: Middle Dardenne Creek drains about 52 square miles, all of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 720 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 450 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Dardenne Creek, Crooked Creek and Schote Creek. St. Charles County communities here include O'Fallon, St. Peters, Cottleville, Dardenne Prairie, Weldon Spring and Lake St. Louis. Downstream, its water passes through the Lower Dardenne Creek, Cuivre Island-Mississippi River and Bolter Island-Mississippi River watersheds on its way down the Mississippi River.
